enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing regularly. Turning to left side. Pulling blanket up. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still. Turning to right side. Pushing blanket down. Pulling blanket up. Lying on back. Eyes closed. Breathing deeply. Turning to left side. Pulling blanket up. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning wash, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Put down toothbrush. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Pick up clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out pan. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Put eggs on plate. Pick up bread. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Wait. Toast pops up. Pick up toast. Put on plate. Open drawer. Take out fork. Close drawer. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Cut eggs. Eat eggs. Pick up toast. Eat toast. Pick up glass. Pour milk. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Put plate in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Look at phone. Check time. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Put on headphones. Play music. Look at phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a clinical shift as a health care professional, caring for patients
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Take out scrubs. Change into scrubs. Put on shoes. Close locker. Walk to ward. Wash hands. Pick up clipboard. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's vitals. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Measure heart rate. Record vitals. Administer medication. Adjust IV. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Take notes. Use computer. Document. Attend meeting. Talk to colleagues.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break during the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Check phone. Stand up. Return tray. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing the clinical shift, monitoring patients and completing documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Check patients. Monitor vitals. Administer medication. Document. Talk to doctors. Assist with procedures. Clean equipment. Wash hands. Talk to patient families. Update charts. Use computer. Attend handover. Talk to colleagues. Check supplies. Restock. Answer phone. Respond to call bell. Walk to patient room. Assess patient. Provide care.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look at phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Take out pan. Close cupboard. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pot on stove. Add water. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Cover pot. Wait. Turn off stove. Pick up bowl. Pour soup into bowl. Pick up spoon. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat soup. Pick up bread. Eat bread. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Put bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Open dishwasher. Pick up plate. Scrape food into trash. Place plate in dishwasher. Pick up glass. Place in dishwasher. Pick up utensils. Place in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Wash counter. Rinse sponge. Wipe counter. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry counter. Hang towel. Wipe stove. Throw away trash. Tie trash bag. Take out trash. Return.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on water heater. Wait. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Lather. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Pick up clothes. Put on comfortable clothes. Hang towel. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Open snack. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Wash hands. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine and running a laundry cycle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Pick up laundry basket. Sort clothes. Open washing machine. Put clothes into washing machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Turn dial to select cycle. Press start button. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time skincare and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on tap. Wet face. Pick up cleanser. Apply to face. Massage. Rinse face. Pat dry. Pick up toner. Apply to cotton pad. Wipe face. Pick up moisturizer. Apply to face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Open drawer. Take out book. Read book. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lying on back. Eyes closed. Breathing deeply. Turning to left side. Pulling blanket up. Adjusting pillow. Remaining still.
